The '''Apalis Coast''' was a rich [[Color/Legends|green]] flatland on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] located south of the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]]. It was separated from the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] by a sheer cliff face. The Apalis Coast was the ancestral homeland of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] and was a reliable source of wealth for them, as the noble family turned the region into productive [[Farm/Legends|farmland]].<ref name="TORC" />

During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], [[House of Thul|House Thul]] invaded the Apalis Coast following a failed attack on [[Castle Organa]], digging up the Organa farms and entrenching themselves there.<ref name="TORC" />
